title: TECHNIQUES FOR FOREST RESOURCE ANALYSIS
description: Use of linear programming, nonlinear programming, dynamic programming, and simulation to solve complex forest management problems, with emphasis on intertemporal multiple-use scheduling. Forestry transportation problems, multiple-use allocation, and investment analysis. Field trips required. CROSSLISTED as FE 457/FOR 457.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: FOR 329 and (FOR 441* or 443).
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of C is required in FOR 329, FOR 441 and FOR 443.
meeting_html: W 2pm-3:50pm in PFSC 217 - Peavy Forest Science Center 217 (9/23 to 12/4)
